metric: gesture commands also reachable from keyboard and gamepad
finding: Only 3 of 12 commands work with a single hand (HOVER, MOVE_DOWN, MOVE_UP); take-off and land need both hands. US-A-01 and the U3 description in SRS 3.1.2.4 expect full one-handed gesture control, so a one-handed operator relies on keyboard or gamepad (which this row confirms).
method: Compares the real mapping tables of GestureAdapter, KeyboardAdapter and GamepadAdapter.
